decision: The stationary association gate is verified: select a high-resolution frame only when distributed visual correspondence and published-frame temporal alignment both pass. The three concurrent pairs passed (18–69 ms); the visually similar 2.10 s control was rejected.
implementation_limit: The integrated moving acquisition still needs to apply this same gate. A stationary pair does not authorize matching high resolution by nearest timestamp alone.

preconditions.e2: Two quiet horizontal views verified as compatible for the configured profile pair.
preconditions.e5: Native profile_2 continuity was verified for one bounded pan and return.
preconditions.e6: E6T measured the local command-to-visual horizon; physical exposure time remains unavailable.

title: Gate para associacao entre baixa e alta resolucao durante aquisicao
